phase: P2-C1 logit gradient norm matched temperature intervention, full ImageNet-200 ID-only

gradient_norm_match.not_matched: aux rank and backbone gradient norm

arm_order: T1 then T6 per seed, sequential on each GPU
same_initialization: seed reset per run; same ImageNet200 train list and validation; per-seed paired
ID_checkpoint_selection: best validation top1 only; no OOD until frozen gate
ID_gate: All six run 60 full epochs; 9000 ID test each; best ID val >=0.80; hashes/protocol valid. If coefficient clips on >10% of samples, mark norm-matching incomplete.
scientific_limit: Exploratory after known five OOD domains. Only logit aux-gradient magnitude targeted; not isolated backbone directions or trajectory causality.
